I am a **doctoral student in Education** in the Science and Mathematics Education research line of the Graduate Program in Education at the Federal University of São Carlos (UFSCar).

I have experience in **systematic reviews** and in **metric studies** (bibliometric and scientometric) in the field of **Statistical Education**, where I investigate the constitution and development of the field in Brazil and Spain. I am currently developing **open-source tools using AI** that can support qualitative research.
